hero.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subhead: The questions we hear most, answered plainly. If yours is not here, contact us.

faqs.heading: Common Questions
faqs.a1: We help you prepare passport and visa applications. That includes confirming requirements, organizing documents and reviewing forms before you submit them.
faqs.a2: No. Visa Expeditor is an independent service. We are not affiliated with any government agency, consulate or embassy.
faqs.a3: No. We are not a law firm and we do not provide legal advice. For legal questions, please consult a qualified professional.
faqs.a4: No. Entry and visa decisions are made solely by the relevant authorities. We help you submit a complete, accurate application.
faqs.q5: How much do your services cost?
faqs.a5: Pricing depends on the service and destination. Government fees are separate and paid to the official authority. Contact us for a clear breakdown.
faqs.q6: How long does an application take?
faqs.a6: Processing times vary by destination, season and application type, and they change over time. Apply as early as the destination allows.
faqs.a7: No. Government fees are paid directly to the official authority. Any service fee we charge is separate and shown clearly.
faqs.a8: It depends on the application. Common items include a valid passport, a compliant photo, proof of funds and supporting documents. We provide a tailored checklist.
faqs.q9: Can I apply if I have been refused before?
faqs.a9: Yes, you can apply again. We can help you review what happened and prepare a stronger application, but we cannot guarantee a different result.
faqs.a10: Use the contact form on this site. Tell us your nationality, destination and purpose of travel, and we will respond with next steps.

cta.title: Question not answered?
cta.body: Send us your details and we will get back to you with a clear answer.
